limits: Actual source loader/IRQ/reader/FIFO publishes during reader packet callbacks while the Z80 consumes; no precomputed replay or synthetic foreground substitute. Native source output/state/IRQ logs checked against reference; proof mode also checks all16intermediate state copies; bare mode checks final RAM/audio and hashes without those copies.

Diagnostic markers delimit publisher callbacks and loader finish before its clock query. Writes before finish/outside publisher show overlap with the live loading call, including remaining diagnostic overhead. The separate query and delivery times are checked against independent native HV reads. No deadline acceptance gate; no DMA/native IRQ/input/boot/full-game/hardware proof. Stop only after drain; no fatal abort implementation.
Publisher consumes due FIFO events with source_psg_queue_take_many: one queue validation and cursor release per batch, original enqueue/plan/transport remain active.

Synchronous polled transfer prepares once per call and retries only WAIT up to the configured attempt limit. Diagnostic grant_wait counts exhausted outer calls, not internal transfer attempts; FULL/errors return immediately. No deferred queue or source work runs inside the polling loop.

H32/224 display enabled with a synthetic repeated diagnostic tile and palette, verified against final physical VRAM/registers/image. CPU mode uploads one32byte tile per publisher callback; DMA mode retains jobs for guarded transfers. This is a diagnostic video fixture, not the game renderer, SMS image fidelity, native IRQs, or full-game proof. Callback marker duration includes video work attempted in that callback.

DMA experiment queues one deterministic diagnostic tile job per callback, tries only with grant/even stamp at most2raw lines old in rawV235..252 (excluding NTSC duplicate range), rechecks after BUSREQ. Precomputed fixed32byte DMA command words issued only inside the granted critical section, source128KiB boundary checked; SGDK auto-increment set before acquisition. Jobs are retained in order and all drained while Z80 clock is still active before stop; some may complete after loader/audio delivery markers. No job frame deadlines or game renderer queue are established; native IRQs remain masked.

Video service experiment wraps the selected source_clock function boundaries (all four or only repeat_disabled) and attempts DMA every configured number of boundaries. Inline source_clock_block and computation inside helpers are not serviced. Adds native cost without changing the logical source clock; no maximum service interval or frame deadline is established.

Diagnostic tile payload is prepared once per queued job and remains intact across WAIT, reset after successful DMA. This removes fixture preparation overhead; DMA primitive/control preparation and its guards remain unchanged. No renderer payload/deadline claim.
Native PSG-word diagnostic markers add writes outside the checked Z80 source-byte stream; these kernels measure source-byte transport/timing and do not establish an unmodified audio waveform.
